description: This file defines the 'QueryCompatibleInputMiddleware' class, which inspects and casts command input values to their modeled types for AWS services that have migrated from query to JSON protocols. It is used internally within the AWS SDK to process API request inputs.

classes.name: QueryCompatibleInputMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that inspects and casts command input parameters to their modeled shapes, handling structures, lists, maps, and scalars for AWS services using query-compatible protocols.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Creates a middleware wrapper function for a given service, returning a closure that instantiates the middleware.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the middleware with a next handler and a service.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Processes the command input, applying shape-based casting, and invokes the next handler.

methods.name: processInput
methods.description: Recursively processes input shapes, dispatching to specific handlers based on the shape type.

methods.name: processStructure
methods.description: Recursively processes structure shapes, applying processing to each member.

methods.name: processList
methods.description: Processes list shapes, applying processing to each list item.

methods.name: processMap
methods.description: Processes map shapes, applying processing to each key-value pair.

methods.name: processScalar
methods.description: Checks and casts scalar input values to their modeled type, issuing warnings if types do not match.

methods.name: changeValueAtPath
methods.description: Modifies the command in place at a specified path to replace the value.

methods.name: isModeledType
methods.description: Determines if a value matches the expected modeled type.

methods.name: castValue
methods.description: Casts a value to the specified type (string, integer, float).
